name: School / College Transfer (SEVIS Transfer)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents_pt: Comprovante de endereço atual nos EUA
documents_es: Comprobante de domicilio actual en EE. UU.
steps: Confirm academic history is consistent with the study plan
Identify current school (transfer from) and new school (transfer to)

phases.name: Execution
steps: Email current school confirming the student can initiate the transfer + transfer date
Email new school regarding the transfer and required documents
Transfer application form completed with document upload to the new school
Wait for the transfer-release form from the new school
Fill out the form and send it to the current school
SEVIS record transferred to the new school
New school issues a new I-20

pricing.notes: Baseline = ESL-to-ESL transfer. Same contract prices ESL-to-College higher at $500 — quote that price when the transfer is into a college/university program.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: Google Drive link for document uploads
Recommendation of two schools based on location, schedule, and cost
Transfer request coordination with both DSOs
standard_excludes: School application fees and SEVIS fee
standard_includes_pt: Link do Google Drive para envio de documentos
Recomendação de duas escolas com base em localização, horário e custo
Coordenação da solicitação de transferência com ambos os DSOs
standard_includes_es: Enlace de Google Drive para subir documentos
Recomendación de dos escuelas según ubicación, horario y costo
Coordinación de la solicitud de transferencia con ambos DSO
